Citizen: Stay away from the D-grade levels!  They're not
just ghetto slums, they're a war zone!  All the gangs and
whacko gun nuts will simply attack you on sight!
Citizen: In case you're curious, the arrows on the floor are
for the robots and also show people what paths they usually
take when they get around.  For people, walk where you want.
The arrows are also for forklifts and other mini-vehicles.
Citizen: Yeah, welcome to Yaster.  All high-tech and
everything.  If you really want fun though, you should
vacation on S'mee'aliere island.  They have some REALLY good
places there, including fireworks, parades, and more.
Here, all the upper-class wealthy types and rich folks are
in the Grade B and Grade A levels where out-of-towners don't
normally go, and they have their own fun.
Our Inns and diners in C aren't too bad though.  Visitors
seem to like them.  People who live here think they're okay.
Our shopping here isn't too bad I guess.
Or you could go to the slums in Grade D and get mugged,
shot, raped, or killed or something...
Don't go there - there's nothing to see there, nothing any
tourist would want!
No shopping there either!  And no Inns!  Just a few greasy
spoon diners, and if you do find an Inn there I wouldn't
dare sleep there!  I don't know of any pub there either,
despite silly rumors!
Citizen: The gangs in the Grade D levels have some sort of
leader.  He never comes out of that place, but never needs
to.  He lives like a king there.  It'd be nice if someone
would get rid of him.  The town guard can't get to him.
Citizen: Experts and their studies explained on the news say
that removal of the Grade D gang boss would not remove the
gangs, yet still result in a positive effect in the form of
a reduction in crime rates for those areas of the supercity.
